name: Ebisu ebUSD

obituary.epitaph: Fixed-rate credit that never found its market
obituary.obituary: Ebisu offered fixed-rate, open-term credit through ebUSD, a Liquity v2 fork minting against weETH, sUSDe, WBTC, LBTC, and stcUSD branches natively on Ethereum and Plasma. Launched in June 2025, it never found scale: supply peaked near $815K and sat below $25K by July 2026. The team explored just-in-time liquidations, multichain issuance, structured looping and leverage vaults, and acquisition options, but could not grow ebUSD liquidity enough to support meaningful borrowing activity. On July 29, 2026 Ebisu announced it would wind down: minting was paused, users were asked to close Troves and withdraw Stability Pool deposits and DEX liquidity, and the frontend will be deprecated on October 30. An orderly, solvent sunset — collateral redemption remained open throughout.

oneLiner: ebUSD is Ebisu's overcollateralized USD stablecoin minted from Liquity-v2 CDP branches backed by weETH, sUSDe, WBTC, LBTC, and stcUSD on Ethereum and Plasma.
collateral: Overcollateralized CDP markets on Ethereum and Plasma using weETH, sUSDe, WBTC, LBTC, and stcUSD; the live adapter reports current per-branch shares, with WETH and XPL configured as additional dormant branches
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with Liquity v2-style user-set interest rates and redemptions; production deployments mint natively on both Ethereum and Plasma

oracleRisk.summary: Twelve debt-bearing Liquity v2 branches on Ethereum and Plasma use immutable branch-local Chainlink or RedStone compositions with strict positive-answer and staleness validation. Invalid aggregator data ordinarily shuts only the affected branch onto lastGoodPrice; insufficient-gas catches and two raw wrapper-rate calls instead revert. Ethereum weETH alone has a canonical-rate failover. Six branches condition redemption pricing on a 2% market/reference band, while paused and dust-debt branches remain liquidation-active.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 ORCL curation
branchApplicability.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 25531806 and Plasma block 27103966, the two official CollateralRegistries returned exactly five and seven branches. Every registered TroveManager and PriceFeed was callable, every ActivePool carried debt, and shutdownTime was zero. Paused LBTC, WXPL, WETH, weETH, syrupUSDT, and sUSDai branches and positive-dust rows remain explicit because liquidation and debt resolution are still live.

branches.label: Ethereum weETH Trove branch
branches.summary: The branch uses strict Chainlink validation and a canonical weETH-rate failover that is activated together with permanent branch shutdown.

feeds.path: PriceFeed 0x36Fb029e6fEeC43d96BE2F8ccC0e572D1663F5fc -> weETH.getRate(); normal pricing and redemption outside a 2% market/canonical band use min, while redemption within the band uses max

branches.fallbackBehavior: If weETH/ETH is invalid, stale, non-positive, or ordinarily reverts, the PriceFeed permanently shuts new borrowing, changes priceSource to ETHUSDxCanonical, and serves ETH/USD multiplied by canonical weETH.getRate(). Invalid ETH/USD or a failing getRate() then shuts onto lastGoodPrice; getRate() is caught as down except when the insufficient-gas guard reverts. The PriceFeed is a non-proxy deployment whose feed addresses and thresholds are constructor-set and expose no owner mutation path.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The reviewed Ebisu deployment materials and verified Ethereum and Plasma token deployments do not establish a direct holder-balance blacklist or freeze inventory for ebUSD. The inherited status is retained for upstream collateral, reserve, custody, and cross-chain dependency exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: ebUSD is minted from Liquity-v2-style CDP branches when users open troves. The BoldToken is an OZ ERC1967Proxy; after setCollateralRegistry() the BoldToken owner was renounced (owner()=0x0). Upgrades are governed by a Gnosis Safe 2/3 (3 EOA owners) via EbisuUpgradeableV2 with a mandatory 7-day on-chain timelock. No pending upgrade exists. CCIP token pools are locked. CDP branches (BorrowerOperations) are the only mint path and their addresses are immutable in the CollateralRegistry.

controls.label: Ebisu CDP BorrowerOperations contracts (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded per branch by collateral ratio and Liquity-v2-style redemption/liquidation; users set their own interest rate. Mint is gated to registered BorrowerOperations addresses set at initialization.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295272: BoldToken proxy (0x09fd37d9...) at EIP-1967 impl 0xa5ae6f43... Source confirms: mint() restricted to BorrowerOperations, ActivePool, or CCIP pools via _requireCallerIsBOorAPorCCIP(). BorrowerOperations addresses are set via CollateralRegistry (0x5e159fac...) at initialization; owner renounced in setCollateralRegistry() call. Follow-up 2026-07-20: Ebisu branch BorrowerOperations contracts verified with live bytecode — Ethereum branches 0x026cf854..., 0x116d3842..., 0x66283665... and Plasma branches 0x061010c0..., 0x2291cbed..., 0x3b338fe0..., 0x3f97c24a..., 0x458d3c3b... (deployment addresses from the Ebisu app configuration; CollateralRegistry 0x5e159fac2d137f7b83a12b9f30ac6ab2ba6d45e7 shared).

controls.label: Ebisu Gnosis Safe (EbisuUpgradeable admin, 7-day timelock)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295272: CollateralRegistry (0x5e159fac..., ERC1967Proxy) ebisuAdmin()=0x25b85831da750c912ab7f0cf53b9d82f7894ed07, a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0. getOwners()=3 EOAs, threshold=2, getModulesPaginated() returns empty array, guard slot=0x0, masterCopy slot0=0xd9db270c... (Safe 1.3.0), fallbackHandler=0xf48f2b2d.... EbisuUpgradeableV2 enforces 7-day UPGRADE_TIMELOCK on-chain. BoldToken slot 354-355=0x0 (pendingImplementation=0x0, upgradeProposalTime=0 — no pending upgrade). BoldToken slot 359=0x1 (ccipTokenPoolsLocked=true). BoldToken owner (slot 101)=0x0 (renounced).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295272: BoldToken (ebUSD) is an ERC1967Proxy (0x09fd37d9...) with impl BoldToken (0xa5ae6f43...). Source-confirmed: setCollateralRegistry() renounces ownership (owner()=0x0 at slot 101). Upgrade admin is Gnosis Safe 2/3 (0x25b85831..., 3 EOA owners, no modules, Safe 1.3.0) gated by 7-day on-chain UPGRADE_TIMELOCK in EbisuUpgradeableV2. No pending upgrade (pendingImplementation=0x0). ccipTokenPoolsLocked=true. Mint is CDP-only via BorrowerOperations addresses set at init and unreachable without an upgrade through the 7-day timelock.

reserveReview.rationale: The independent Liquity-v2 branch producer read every configured positive Ebisu branch in one current Ethereum capture and normalized the exact stcUSD, sUSDe, WBTC, weETH, and LBTC collateral values. Tracked savings wrappers retain their upstream dependency links, while the three crypto collateral rows retain their market, liquidity, custody, counterparty, and smart-contract failure domains.
